# How do I get PROS gas?

PROS is the gas token on **Pharos Mainnet**. Get it through [Get PROS Gas](/getting-started/get-pros-gas.md):

* **Already have crypto in a wallet:** Use Halliday’s **Use crypto** option to send PROS to your wallet.
* **Have crypto on an exchange:** Withdraw to your wallet and select **Pharos** as the network.
* **Paying with cash:** Use Halliday’s **Use cash** option or Alchemy Pay on [port.pharos.xyz/get-pros](https://port.pharos.xyz/get-pros).
* **Need a wallet:** Use the TopNod option on that page.

Check the destination address before confirming. Never share your seed phrase or private key. Afterward, verify the PROS balance on [Pharos Scan](https://www.pharosscan.xyz).
